summary: Auth-gating remediation verified end-to-end. 39 pytest tests PASS + 1 skipped (remediation skipped: no infected device — pre-cleaned in prior iteration; not a regression). All public endpoints (GET /api/, /api/stats) return 200 without auth. All 9 protected GETs return 401 without token and 200 with Bearer test_session_auditor_01. All 6 tested mutating POSTs return 401 without auth. /api/auth/me returns correct user, /api/auth/logout returns {ok:true}. Frontend: /login renders google-login-btn, unauth /dashboard redirects to /login (ProtectedRoute), session_token cookie unlocks /dashboard, sidebar nav (overview/network/community/remediation) works, sign-out returns to /login. Scanner widget executes URL scan successfully (verdict SUSPICIOUS, risk 58, AI reasoning + IOCs + actions rendered). EICAR upload with auth => verdict=malicious, clamav_summary.signature='Eicar-Test-Signature', circl_summary.known_malicious=true. Clean upload => verdict=clean. Upload without auth => 401. 1GB cap logic present in scan_upload().
critical_code_review_comments: SEC gating implementation is clean: single Depends(get_current_user) applied at router-include level in server.py — no per-endpoint drift possible.
get_current_user accepts BOTH cookie (session_token) and Authorization: Bearer, correctly handles tz-naive vs tz-aware expires_at, and deletes expired sessions. Good.
scan_upload streams in 1MB chunks with cumulative size check and 413 on overflow — matches SEC-003 requirement. tempfile is properly cleaned in finally block.
Prior iteration_1 caveats still apply (server.py still ~60 lines but now delegates to routers/ — actually fixed via router split, good progress).
Info-only: /auth/logout returns 200 even without a valid token (idempotent). Documented behaviour, not a bug.

Frontend scan-threat-intel panel is conditionally rendered when circl_summary or clamav_summary are populated; URL-target scans (no hash) don't show it — this is intentional. Verified via EICAR upload path in backend where both panels are populated.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_auditor_01 / cookie session_token=test_session_auditor_01 (user auditor@sentinelgrid.local). Re-seeded twice during this run because logout deletes the session; use /app/memory/test_credentials.md re-seed snippet if next agent needs it.
